definition: A distinct manual user question with a stable direct URL; multi-mode workspaces are not double-counted.

tasks.title: Trade PnL Calculator
tasks.question: What signed gain or loss follows from a manual entry, exit, size and fees?
tasks.output: Signed trade profit or loss
tasks.assumptions: Manual spot-style prices; no tax cost-basis or live trade data.

tasks.title: Swap Cost Simulator
tasks.question: Which of two manual swap scenarios has lower modeled total cost?
tasks.output: Coverage-aware route comparison
tasks.assumptions: No executable quote, wallet call, live gas or guaranteed settlement.

tasks.title: Bridge Cost Comparator
tasks.question: Which hypothetical cross-chain route delivers more modeled destination value?
tasks.output: Coverage-aware destination-value comparison
tasks.assumptions: Chain labels do not prove provider support or asset redeemability.

tasks.title: Portfolio Exposure Analyzer
tasks.question: How are manually valued spot holdings allocated and concentrated?
tasks.output: Known subtotal, exposure groups, concentration and coverage
tasks.assumptions: Unknown prices never become zero; not a wallet scanner or risk score.

tasks.title: Generic Liquidation Price
tasks.question: At what manual isolated-position price does a stated maintenance threshold occur?
tasks.output: Modeled threshold price
tasks.assumptions: Generic arithmetic, not protocol liquidation rules or execution guarantee.

tasks.title: 50/50 Pool Impermanent Loss

tasks.output: Illustrative LP-versus-HODL divergence
tasks.assumptions: Excludes fees, gas, concentrated liquidity and live pool data.

tasks.title: Convert ETH, gwei and wei
tasks.question: How many wei or gwei are in a stated ETH amount?

tasks.assumptions: Unit conversion only; no exchange rate or chain lookup.

tasks.title: Convert token amount and base units
tasks.question: What is a token amount in raw base units at stated decimals?
tasks.output: Exact raw or human-readable token amount
tasks.assumptions: Decimals and label are manual; no token identity is verified.

tasks.title: Convert percent, bps and ppm
tasks.question: How does one rate translate between percent, basis points and ppm?
tasks.output: Exact equivalent rate denominations
tasks.assumptions: A denomination conversion is not an APR/APY conversion.

tasks.title: Apply a stated fee rate
tasks.question: What fee and remaining amount follow from a manual rate?

tasks.assumptions: The fee rate is manual and applied once; no venue quote is checked.

tasks.title: Convert nominal APR to APY
tasks.question: What effective APY follows from a nominal APR and compounding frequency?
tasks.output: Modeled effective APY
tasks.assumptions: Constant nominal rate and discrete compounding; no future yield guarantee.

tasks.title: Convert APY to nominal APR
tasks.question: What nominal APR corresponds to a stated APY and compounding schedule?
tasks.output: Bounded inverse nominal APR
tasks.assumptions: A deterministic inverse within documented precision; rates are assumptions.

tasks.title: Annualize a periodic return
tasks.question: What annualized return follows if one period return repeats?
tasks.output: Modeled annualized return
tasks.assumptions: Repeated constant period return is illustrative, not observed performance.

tasks.title: Calculate simple-interest growth
tasks.question: What is a future value under simple interest?
tasks.output: Starting principal, modeled growth and future value
tasks.assumptions: Whole years, one manual currency, no compounding or taxes.

tasks.title: Calculate compound growth
tasks.question: What future value follows from discrete compounding?
tasks.output: Modeled growth and future value
tasks.assumptions: Whole periods and fixed nominal APR; no prediction.

tasks.title: Model recurring contributions
tasks.question: How does beginning versus end contribution timing change growth?
tasks.output: Principal, contributions, growth and ending value
tasks.assumptions: Fixed manual rate and whole periods; contribution timing is explicit.

tasks.title: Estimate principal for annual income
tasks.question: What principal would a stated income require at an assumed APY?
tasks.output: Conservatively rounded required principal
tasks.assumptions: Assumed APY is not guaranteed income or a recommendation.

tasks.title: Calculate gain needed after a loss
tasks.question: What gain would restore a value after a percentage loss?
tasks.output: Required recovery gain or unreachable status
tasks.assumptions: Price-only arithmetic; fees and new capital are excluded.

tasks.title: Calculate weighted average entry
tasks.question: What was the fee-adjusted entry across manual spot fills?
tasks.output: Gross and adjusted average entry and break-even exit
tasks.assumptions: Long-only spot; fees must share the quote unit; not tax cost basis.

tasks.title: Size a long-only stop scenario
tasks.question: What quantity fits a stated modeled stop-loss budget?
tasks.output: Modeled loss and conservatively bounded quantity
tasks.assumptions: A stop may execute at a worse price; not maximum real-world loss.

tasks.title: Compare modeled risk and reward
tasks.question: What is net target reward relative to modeled stop loss?
tasks.output: Net reward, loss and reward-to-risk ratio
tasks.assumptions: Manual long-only prices; no fill or target outcome is guaranteed.

tasks.title: Measure bid–ask spread
tasks.question: How wide is a manual bid–ask spread relative to its midpoint?

tasks.title: Calculate slippage bounds

tasks.title: Estimate a transaction gas budget

tasks.title: Plan a target allocation

tasks.title: Rebalance using contributions only

tasks.title: Model a portfolio shock

tasks.assumptions: Flows occur at each interval end; missing valuation boundaries cannot be reconstructed.

tasks.title: Analyze drawdown and recovery

tasks.title: Project simple staking rewards

tasks.title: Check modeled claim economics

tasks.title: Compare restaking and penalties

tasks.assumptions: Same-asset assumption must be explicit; slashing and returns are hypothetical.

tasks.title: Calculate linear vesting with cliff

tasks.title: Calculate collateral health and headroom

tasks.output: LTV, health factor and constrained debt headroom

tasks.title: Model repay, add and withdraw limits

tasks.title: Stress a single collateral value

tasks.title: Compare simple and compounded debt

tasks.output: Simple and compound financing cost and final debt
tasks.assumptions: Fixed nominal APR; entered horizons must describe the intended comparison.

tasks.title: Model fixed debt repayments
tasks.question: How does an end-of-period payment split between interest and principal?
tasks.output: Period interest, principal reduction and payoff status
tasks.assumptions: Fixed rate and end-of-period payments; no variable-rate forecast.

tasks.title: Compare manual yield and borrowing cost
tasks.question: Would an assumed investment return exceed known financing costs?
tasks.output: Earnings, borrowing cost and coverage-aware net carry
tasks.assumptions: One manual currency; unknown expenses withhold a net-profit conclusion.

tasks.title: Read an AMM reserve-implied price
tasks.question: What marginal price and invariant follow from manual pool reserves?

tasks.assumptions: Constant-product illustration, not live liquidity or a swap quote.

tasks.title: Simulate a constant-product swap

tasks.title: Model proportional pool liquidity
tasks.question: What paired deposit or withdrawal preserves a pool reserve ratio?

tasks.assumptions: Fee-free illustrative ownership, not protocol LP minting.

tasks.title: Inspect concentrated position composition

tasks.output: Modeled token amounts, liquidity and unspent budgets
tasks.assumptions: Continuous fee-free range model, not Uniswap v3 contract-equivalent.

tasks.title: Compare LP and HODL at another price
tasks.question: How does the same initial position compare with holding at a future price?
tasks.output: LP value, matched HODL value and relative divergence
tasks.assumptions: No fee prediction; a negative relative difference is not necessarily absolute loss.

tasks.title: Check concentrated LP fee break-even
tasks.question: What manually accrued fees cover modeled LP-versus-HODL divergence?
tasks.output: Break-even fees and coverage-aware net comparison
tasks.assumptions: Unknown costs prevent definitive profit assessment; no volume forecast.

tasks.title: Validate an EVM address checksum

tasks.output: Preview, normalized strings and invalid-field report
tasks.assumptions: No tax categorization, silent rounding or storage write.

tasks.question: Which rows share selected identity columns and need review?
tasks.output: Duplicate/conflict groups and local reviewed exports
tasks.assumptions: Matching amount/time alone does not prove the same blockchain event.

tasks.assumptions: European expiry payoff in one quote unit; no exercise, assignment or fees.

tasks.title: Portfolio Greeks Aggregator
tasks.question: What aggregate sensitivities follow from option positions sharing one underlying and unit convention?
tasks.output: Signed delta, gamma, vega, theta and rho totals
tasks.assumptions: One underlying, quote currency and snapshot; vega/rho per 1.00 change, theta per year.

tasks.title: Volatility Smile Analyzer
tasks.question: How do manually entered implied volatilities vary with strike for one expiry?
tasks.output: Sorted strike-IV plot and wing comparison
tasks.assumptions: Entered observations only, one expiry and observation time; no live quote or interpolation.

tasks.title: Delta Hedge Simulator
tasks.question: How many underlying units would offset a stated option delta at a target?
tasks.output: Hypothetical hedge adjustment and known proportional fee
tasks.assumptions: Delta and hedge quantities are in the same verified underlying; prices and Greeks are fixed assumptions.

tasks.title: Futures Hedge Calculator
tasks.question: How many whole futures contracts cover a chosen fraction of a manual exposure?
tasks.output: Conservative contract count and uncovered target notional
tasks.assumptions: One quote currency; static beta and contract notional; excludes margin, basis and fees.

tasks.title: Funding History Analyzer
tasks.question: What net funding was paid or received across explicitly listed settlements?
tasks.output: Net signed funding plus paid and received totals
tasks.assumptions: Each dated row is one settlement; missing observations are not reconstructed.

tasks.title: Trading Journal Analyzer
tasks.question: What net outcome and streak statistics follow from manually supplied closed trades?
tasks.output: Net PnL, win rate, profit factor and losing streak
tasks.assumptions: Closed trades in one manual quote currency and supplied row order; no Taxlot or tax conclusions.

tasks.title: Order Book Depth Simulator
tasks.question: How much of a hypothetical order can the entered book levels fill?
tasks.output: Filled quantity, VWAP, quote cost and depth shortfall
tasks.assumptions: A static manually entered book, not live or executable; queue priority and hidden liquidity excluded.
